{{External|rs}} {{HasTask|Dogs}} {{Infobox Monster |name = Jackal |image = [[File:Jackal.png|200px]] |release = [[26 April]] [[2005]] |update = Desert Month Finale |members = Yes |combat = 21 |size = 1 |examine = He has had his day. |xpbonus = 0 |max hit = 3 |aggressive = Yes |poisonous = No |attack style = [[Stab]] |attack speed = 4 |respawn = 50 |slayxp = 27 |cat = Dogs |assignedby = turael,spria,mazchna |hitpoints = 27 |att = 17 |str = 18 |def = 15 |mage = 1 |range = 1 |attbns = 0 |strbns = 0 |amagic = 0 |mbns = 0 |arange = 0 |rngbns = 0 |dstab = 0 |dslash = 0 |dcrush = 0 |dmagic = 0 |dlight = 0 |dstandard = 0 |dheavy = 0 |elementalweaknesstype = Fire |elementalweaknesspercent = 10 |poisonresistance = 0 |venomresistance = 0 |immunecannon = No |immunethrall = No |id = 4185,11583 }} '''Jackals''' are a species of small, [[dog]]-like creatures native to the [[Kharidian Desert]]. Jackals are commonly found in the desert's lower reaches, near the cities of [[Nardah]] and [[Sophanem]]. Jackals travel in large packs. These packs use their numbers to take down prey much larger than themselves, including [[human]]s that have often been weakened by the [[desert heat]].
